title: The Port’s grant was extended. Then its federal funding fell by $237,020.

beats.text: A federal grant for the Port started in 2014.

visual.sub: The Board authorized the award after its start

beats.text: The Board approved it retroactively in November 2015.

visual.kicker: The Board authorized the award after its start

beats.text: The award letter lists the local contribution separately from the federal grant.

visual.label: The Board authorized the award after its start

beats.text: Federal environmental and historic review took time.

visual.kicker: The oversight report explains the delay

beats.text: The analyst counted ten months left on the original clock.
The federal record shows the award period extended through July 2017.

visual.kicker: The federal award period was extended

beats.text: Then the last federal transaction reduced the obligation.

visual.label: The last transaction reduced the obligation

beats.text: That left the smaller amount recorded in the federal award summary.

visual.label: The last transaction reduced the obligation

beats.text: The December entry records a change in funding. It does not show a check from the Port.

visual.kicker: The last transaction reduced the obligation

beats.text: The public record gives no total outlay. The reason for the reduction remains an open question.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
